### Assyria Invades Judah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/assyria-invades-judah
Passage: 2 Kings 18:35
Points:
- King Ahaz's past compromise with Assyria brought spiritual compromise and heavy tributary burdens upon Judah.
- King Hezekiah rebelled against Assyria as part of his broader mission to purge foreign idolatry from the nation.
- Sennacherib invaded Judah and besieged Jerusalem, bringing the kingdom into its most desperate hour.
- Sennacherib's official mocked the Lord, claiming Yahweh was powerless to stop Assyria just like the pagan deities.
- Even when circumstances seem hopeless, believers can trust that the enemies of God will ultimately be defeated.
